name: Azariah (son of Maaseiah)
title: Repaired the wall at his house
summary: Azariah, son of Maaseiah, worked on the rebuilding of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time, in the section located right next to his own house.

keyEvents.title: Repairs the wall
keyEvents.description: Azariah, son of Maaseiah, repaired the wall beside his own house.
